title: Calendar
overview: This guide covers calendar workflows for Super Admin.

subtasks.title: Manage Visit Types
subtasks.purpose: Add and edit the visit templates used across practices.

subtasks.title: Set Working Hours
subtasks.purpose: Define the availability window per day of the week.

steps.title: Choose Schedule Date Range
steps.description: Choose the date range the schedule applies to.

steps.title: Set Daily Work Hours
steps.description: For each day of the week, enter the start and end time (add multiple ranges for split shifts).

subtasks.title: Book on the Calendar Grid
subtasks.purpose: The Programs module defines the care programs practices enroll patients into. Each program bundles a category, billing codes, reimbursement values, clinical requirements, and a visual identity.

steps.title: Pick Calendar Month
steps.description: Pick a month from the mini-calendar.

steps.title: Toggle Caregiver Visibility
steps.description: Toggle caregivers on/off in the sidebar to layer their availability.

steps.title: Book a Visit
steps.description: Click an empty slot to open the booking dialog and choose a Visit Type (see 14.2).
